def gen(rng, max_instr=5, max_mem=3, max_threads=3):
    m = rng.randint(1, max_mem)

    nt = rng.randint(1, max_threads)

            if op == 'load':
                th.append(['load', a, w])

    """Value observed by a load: per byte, youngest buffered store wins."""
    v = (mem >> (8 * addr)) & ((1 << (8 * width)) - 1)
    for sa, sw, sv in buf:  # oldest first; younger stores overwrite
        lo = sa if sa > addr else addr

    """Value observed by a load: per byte, the youngest buffered store wins."""
    v = (mem >> (8 * addr)) & ((1 << (8 * width)) - 1)
    for sa, sw, sv in buf:  # oldest first; younger stores overwrite
        lo = sa if sa > addr else addr
        hi = sa + sw
        end = addr + width

def _load_value(mem, buf, addr, width):
    """Value observed by a load: per byte, the youngest buffered store wins."""
    v = (mem >> (8 * addr)) & ((1 << (8 * width)) - 1)
    for sa, sw, sv in buf:  # oldest first; younger stores overwrite
        lo = sa if sa > addr else addr
        hi = sa + sw
        end = addr + width
        if hi > end:
            hi = end
        if lo < hi:
            for b in range(lo, hi):
                shift = 8 * (b - addr)
                byte = (sv >> (8 * (b - sa))) & 0xFF
                v = (v & ~(0xFF << shift)) | (byte << shift)
    return v


def _write_value(mem, addr, width, value):
    mask = ((1 << (8 * width)) - 1) << (8 * addr)
    return (mem & ~mask) | ((value & ((1 << (8 * width)) - 1)) << (8 * addr))
